access.title: A stronger community
access.subtitle: Welcome people in and see what helps them keep going.
access.demo: Sample owner space. Invitations and changes stay in this browser; no email is sent.
access.invitationHint: Send a private invitation tied to one email address. It expires in 7 days and can be used once.
access.noInvitations: Good company starts with an invitation
access.noInvitationsHint: Invite someone to build their own training routine.
access.copyHint: Share this link only with its recipient. Resending replaces the previous link.
access.independent: Each person gets their own private training space. Their health records and conversations stay private.

delivery.sent: Invitation email sent. You can also copy the same link below.
delivery.captured: Test invitation captured. Copy the link to try the flow; no external email was sent.
delivery.not_configured: Email delivery needs setup. You can share the link below now.
delivery.failed: Email could not be delivered. Share this link or resend the invitation.

errors.generic: We couldn't complete that step. Please try again.
errors.invalid: This invitation link is invalid or was replaced. Ask the owner for a new invitation.
errors.wrongEmail: This invitation belongs to another email. Switch to the Google account that received it.
errors.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the owner to resend it.
errors.revoked: This invitation was revoked. Ask the owner for a new one.
errors.rejected: Your access was declined. Contact the owner to restore it.
errors.used: This invitation has already been accepted.
errors.setup: Invitations need a little setup before they can be sent. Contact the app owner.
errors.copy: Clipboard access is unavailable. Select and copy the link manually.

welcome.title: Your next chapter starts here
welcome.body: A friendly space for your training, progress, and everyday wins. Sign in with the email that received your invitation.
welcome.private: Your measurements, health records, and conversations are private to you.
welcome.successBody: Your personal space is ready. We'll help you find a comfortable starting point.

analytics.chartLabel: Daily active users over the selected period
analytics.actionsHint: Aggregated interactions collected since this feature was enabled. No weights, repetitions, exercise names or chat content are recorded. Edits count when leaving a field; counts do not represent unique people.
analytics.funnelHint: All-time milestones since tracking began. Earlier records are shown separately.
analytics.retentionHint_one: Day 7 return rate includes {{count}} person with a full return day completed.
analytics.retentionHint_other: Day 7 return rate includes {{count}} people with a full return day completed.
analytics.privacy: Activity shows app actions only. Personal health details and chat content stay private.
analytics.noData: Activity will appear here as people begin using their space.
analytics.exclusions: Owner activity and production test accounts are excluded. Visits reset after 30 minutes of inactivity.
